title.zh: 臺科大校園建築 BIM 擬真建模專案

description.en: Detailed 3D architectural and structural BIM modeling created with Autodesk Revit, featuring custom parametric families and clash detection.

title.zh: 城市文化中心建築設計

description.en: Conceptual design and visualization focusing on spatial flow, structural logic, and sustainable environmental integration.
